comparisons.reason: Different constructs. Feature 0 is 1 when the OP explicitly marks uncertainty about their own view, such as 'I might be wrong' or 'not sure'. Feature 1 is 1 when the OP makes at least one flat, unqualified absolute or universal claim. They are not opposites: feature 1's spec says both can be 1 for the same row. The source column (argument) and the null rule match, but the extraction predicates differ.
